text:
toni (Product): Quick sync: final pass on Autoscale modal microcopy and focus states. Figma link: https://figma.redwood/autoscale-clarity — please call out anything that could confuse customers.
izzy (Design): Main confusion from research: "Min/Max" labels get lost when autoscale toggled on. Proposal: keep numbers visible but visually muted and add text 'Managed by autoscale' under each when enabled.
ravi (Frontend): Keyboard expectations: allow direct typing, arrow keys, Home/End. When autoscale on, the inputs should be aria-disabled but still focusable so screenreaders can read why they're disabled. Add aria-describedby pointing to the helper text.
megan (Engineering): Backend note: don't apply changes until user hits Apply. For quick previews we can run a cheap estimate but debounce to 400ms and rate-limit per-session. Also guardrail: warn if requested burst > pool quota.
izzy (Design): Copy suggestions: change "Burst" to "Temporary capacity" in all UI. Helper line under it: "Adds GPUs for short spikes; billed while active." For the SLO slider small copy: "Target p50 latency — lower value increases capacity and cost."
a11y-bot: Accessibility checks: 1) slider must announce value changes via aria-live, 2) ensure contrast of muted labels >= 3:1 at minimum and provide non-color cues, 3) tooltips reachable by keyboard, 4) sequence: autoscale toggle -> SLO slider -> min numeric -> max numeric -> burst -> Apply.
toni (Product): Decision items: keep muted but visible min/max with helper text; implement aria-describedby; change Burst wording to "Temporary capacity"; debounce previews 400ms; show soft-warning banner for large cost delta.
izzy (Design): I'll update Figma and add a small caution icon for the soft-warning.
ravi (Frontend): I'll implement focusable disabled inputs + aria-describedby and the keyboard behaviors. Adding storybook tests.
megan (Engineering): I'll implement debounce and quota check. If quota exceeded show inline error preventing Apply.
toni (Product): Thanks — please post PR links when ready. Aim to ship this week if no blockers. :shipit:
